content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** WARRANTY — **deviation**. Article 15 gives only Effective-Date status/IP representations (15.1, 15.2) plus a broad disclaimer of merchantability, fitness and non-infringement (15.4); product conformity is deferred to supply/quality agreements yet to be negotiated (9.3, 9.4(b)(i)). There is no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair/replacement or refund remedy anywhere, so the clause fails the fallback. I inserted a single new Section 15.5 carrying exactly the four fallback elements — 90 days for supplied Materials against specifications, 30 days for Array's services, with repair, replacement or refund — positioned so that 15.4's "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement" carve-out preserves it.
